summary: Learn ISO 45003:2021 psychosocial risk assessment, controls, and incident management. Build practical tools for safer workplaces. Enrol today.
lede: Psychosocial risk management training helps OHS, HR and employee-relations professionals identify workplace hazards and organise preventive responses. Participants practise assessing exposure, prioritising controls, handling sensitive incidents and recording evidence in risk registers and response workflows. The course also covers worker consultation and monitoring effectiveness through indicators and dashboards, supporting integration with occupational health and safety processes.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who must connect psychosocial risk management with daily OHS controls, HR governance, employee relations, and workforce wellbeing. It is designed for roles that make decisions about exposure, prevention, response, and reporting in high-pressure workplaces.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to occupational health and safety, human resources, employee relations, workplace wellbeing, or organisational risk. No coding or programming is required. You should bring a current or representative workplace process, policy, or risk challenge for application exercises. Advanced digital analytics and AI-assisted thematic analysis receive operational application treatment, not technical engineering or production deployment.
